name: offline_protocol_v1
status: declared before any model was trained on the six-month data; changes require a new version

data.split: configs/split_eclog6m_v1.json (client-grouped; frozen-model training clients forced into train)
data.labels: session label from user agent exactly as label_eclog.py; 'unknown' sessions excluded from training and metrics
data.timestamps: EClog 1 s resolution, used as is (definitions unchanged); the resolution effect is a separate declared sensitivity experiment (audit N1)

rows.prefix: pre_* columns: feature vector at the gateway's first scoring point (non-static count > 20 and duration >= 3 s; gateway_emulator.first_score); only sessions with scored == 1
rows.completed: done_* columns: label_eclog.py completed-session vector; for training the completed model, sessions with n_non_static > 20 and duration_s >= 3 (the sessions the gateway can score), so both new models see the same sessions

eclog6m_completed_8feature_v1.train_rows: completed rows of the same train-split sessions

common.estimator: xgboost.XGBClassifier(n_estimators=100, max_depth=6, learning_rate=0.1, random_state=42, eval_metric='logloss') — the frozen timing model's settings, no tuning
common.sample_weight: none (one row per session, as the frozen models)
common.freeze: pickled, SHA-256 recorded in ml_pipeline/models/frozen_models_manifest_v7.json before any test-split metric is computed

baseline_markov.definition: first-order Markov chain over canonical non-static paths of the session prefix up to the first scoring point; one chain per class from train-split sessions; paths seen in fewer than 5 train sessions mapped to <UNK>; add-one smoothing; score = log P(seq|bot) - log P(seq|human) per transition (length-normalised)
baseline_markov.threshold: selected on validation exactly as for the other models

evaluation.primary_unit: client: clients of the split with >= 1 scored known-label session; client label = the label of its scored known sessions when they all agree, mixed-label clients excluded (count reported); client score = max over its scored sessions (the campaign 'ever flagged' rule)
evaluation.primary_inputs: prefix vectors (what the gateway scores); completed vectors reported as secondary

thresholds.validation_selected: per model, the smallest threshold whose VALIDATION client-level FPR <= 1 %; applied unchanged to test
thresholds.matched_fpr_validation: per model, thresholds giving validation client-level FPR <= 1 % and <= 5 %; test recall and test FPR reported
thresholds.matched_fpr_test_descriptive: recall at test FPR = 1 % and 5 % read off the test ROC; labelled descriptive (not a deployable operating point)
thresholds.fixed: frozen models also at their fixed thresholds (0.5, 0.35)

metrics: recall, FPR, precision with confusion counts
reliability curve: 10 equal-width bins, counts and observed bot rate per bin
evaluation.coverage: share of known-label sessions and clients (all splits and per split) with n_non_static >= k and duration_s >= 3, k in {5, 10, 15, 21}; k = 21 equals the gateway gate
evaluation.zanbil: no retraining and calibration-only variants declared; BLOCKED: restricted Dataverse file, no verified copy available
